review.alternative: Task repertoires might be pre-compiled via static heuristic search rather than genuine autonomous goal generation.
review.would_change_mind: Empirical data showing that agent-generated goals yield lower adaptive competence than fixed human heuristic sets.

claims.statement: Goal-based open-ended autonomous learning enables systems to self-generate tasks and accelerate skill acquisition without continuous human intervention.

support.explanation: Demonstrates that self-generated goals provide the foundational driver for open-ended skill acquisition.
support.passage: Autonomous robots are capable of performing tasks in real-life environments without the need for human operators. The EU-funded GOAL-Robots project will develop a groundbreaking approach to designing and constructing robots with open-ended learning capabilities.

actions.findings: Goal-based open-ended autonomous learning enables systems to self-generate tasks and accelerate skill acquisition without continuous human intervention. [source-eddc1929810c4206]
actions.limitations: Existing evaluations remain heavily centered on simulated environments and structured testbeds; scaling these mechanisms to open-ended real-world scientific inquiry requires further empirical validation.
actions.next_questions: How can self-generated goal mechanisms be quantitatively benchmarked against human-driven research prioritization across complex domains?
